hero.label: Made for Bloom
hero.headline: I want to help Bloom own the brand infrastructure category.
hero.subheadline: Bloom launched in December 2025, went viral with 15K signups, and is backed by Guillermo Rauch. You are building brand-as-infrastructure for the AI era and need someone who can turn that momentum into a repeatable growth engine. That intersection of early traction, technical vision, and category creation is exactly where I want to work.

whyCompany.title: Brand-as-infrastructure is a category worth owning right now
whyCompany.body: Every agent, app, and platform spinning up today has a brand problem and no clean way to solve it. Bloom is positioning itself as the callable brand layer that fixes this at the infrastructure level, not the template level. That framing is rare and the timing relative to the AI agent wave is as good as it gets.

whyCompany.title: 15K signups and a founding growth hire means the real work starts now
whyCompany.body: Viral launch momentum is a window, not a guarantee. The founding growth role is about converting that awareness into durable acquisition loops, partnerships, and monetization before the window closes. Joining at exactly this inflection point, before the playbook is written, is the kind of opportunity that does not come twice.

whyCompany.title: Cold outreach and digital marketing built for this exact moment
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran LinkedIn sequences and cold outreach that helped land 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, working HubSpot and building pipeline with no brand behind me. At NextAfter I moved into B2B digital marketing and learned how consultancies grow through content and conversion. Bloom needs someone who can do both, and I have done both.

quote: I spent a year convincing strangers to trust a product with no reputation, and another summer learning how digital content turns attention into revenue. Bloom already has the attention. I want to be the person who turns it into a category.
